GREEN.headline: You fit take care of this one for house for now.
steps: Rest, drink water well, and dey watch how you dey feel.
Use simple home care wey fit how you dey feel.
GREEN.escalateIf: If e dey worse, e dey last pass how e suppose, or new sign show, go clinic or see doctor.

YELLOW.headline: E better make you see health worker soon.
steps: Go Primary Health Centre (PHC), clinic, or pharmacy/doctor inside the next 24–48 hours.
Write down how you dey feel, when e start, and anything wey dey make am better or worse.
Carry any medicine wey you dey take, with the pack, go with you.
YELLOW.escalateIf: If e dey worse quick quick or any emergency danger sign show, go the nearest hospital now now.

RED.headline: This fit be emergency – get help now now.
steps: Go the nearest hospital or general hospital emergency now now.
If you fit, find quick, safe motor or ask person to help carry you reach there.
No wait make e better by itself.
RED.escalateIf: If the person no dey respond, stop to breathe, or e dey worse fast, find the fastest emergency help wey dey.
